extension.author: Nicolau Roca
extension.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later
extension.description: Read-only HTTPS inventory connector. Configure a unique site UUID and SHA-256 digest of a random 32-byte bearer credential. Empty digest revokes access. Development only.

field.name: site_id
field.label: Site UUID
field.description: Unique UUID v4 for this installation. Keep it when rotating credentials; change it on clones.

field.name: token_hash
field.label: Credential SHA-256 digest
field.description: 64 lowercase hex characters. Never paste the bearer credential here. Empty revokes access immediately.
